## What needs a person

- **post** (0.25h, human): Read applications/nouns-dao/proposal.md end to end, then paste it to the DAO forum as a candidate yourself (forum_url or url in call.md). Start the clock: fund d:post nouns-dao --url <thread-url>. fund run nouns-dao then refreshes proposal.md with the withdraw date; paste that over the post.
- **sponsor-hunt** (1h, blocked): Ask voters and delegates to sponsor the candidate (forum thread, Discord, X). Log every ask by role, never contact details: fund d:log nouns-dao --who "Noun owner" --channel Discord --ask "Sponsor the candidate?" --response pending (re-log with --response yes when someone agrees). Check daily: fund d:clock nouns-dao. On KILL: fund status nouns-dao parked --next "No sponsor in kill window"
- **submit** (0.5h, blocked): The sponsor puts the candidate onchain (or you submit it together through the DAO's governance UI). You sign nothing from this framework. When it is a live proposal: fund done nouns-dao submit
